title.zh: 最早的文明：美索不达米亚与古埃及

clips.send: Egypt: New Kingdom. c. 1550–1069 BCE, peak under Thutmose III, c. 1450 BCE. Under Thutmose III (15th century BCE) Egypt became a great empire spanning Africa and Asia, from Nubia to the Euphrates. Pharaohs were now buried in the Valley of the Kings near Thebes — including Tutankhamun (c. 1323 BCE).

clips.send: Persian (Achaemenid) Empire. 550–330 BCE. Cyrus the Great built an empire from Anatolia (Turkey) to Central Asia. It took Babylon in 539 BCE. Next lesson: how the Persians ran such a huge empire with roads, satraps and coins.

clips.send: Ptolemaic Egypt. 305–30 BCE. Alexander the Great took Egypt in 332 BCE and founded Alexandria. His general Ptolemy’s family then ruled as pharaohs. The Rosetta Stone (196 BCE) is one of their decrees. Cleopatra VII was the last; in 30 BCE Egypt became a province of Rome.

clips.send: Akkadian Empire. c. 2334–2154 BCE. Sargon of Akkad conquered the Sumerian cities and created what is often called the first empire: many peoples under one ruler. It lasted less than 200 years before breaking apart.

clips.send: Mesopotamia. Today: mainly Iraq. Between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, people built some of the world’s first cities and invented cuneiform writing and the wheel.

clips.send: Egypt: Early Dynastic and Old Kingdom. c. 3100–2181 BCE. Around 3100 BCE Upper (southern) and Lower (northern) Egypt were united under one king — traditionally Narmer (Menes). The Old Kingdom is the “Age of the Pyramids”: Djoser’s step pyramid (c. 2650 BCE) and the Great Pyramid of Khufu (c. 2560 BCE). The pharaoh was seen as a living god with absolute power.

clips.send: Neo-Babylonian (Chaldean) Empire. c. 626–539 BCE. King Nebuchadnezzar II rebuilt Babylon with the blue-glazed Ishtar Gate. Stories of the “Hanging Gardens” come from this time (no one has found them). In 539 BCE Cyrus the Great of Persia took Babylon without a long siege.

clips.send: Assyrian Empire. Empire c. 745–609 BCE. At its largest (c. 670 BCE) Assyria ruled from Egypt to western Iran — the biggest empire the world had yet seen. King Ashurbanipal collected a library of thousands of clay tablets at Nineveh, including the Epic of Gilgamesh.

clips.send: Old Babylonian Kingdom (Hammurabi). c. 1894–1595 BCE, Hammurabi ruled c. 1792–1750 BCE. Around the 18th century BCE, King Hammurabi united most of Mesopotamia under Babylon. He issued the Code of Hammurabi — 282 laws carved on a stone pillar, the oldest fairly complete written law code to survive. It showed that the king’s power came from the gods.

clips.send: Third Dynasty of Ur. c. 2112–2004 BCE. King Ur-Nammu built the great Ziggurat of Ur and issued the Code of Ur-Nammu — the oldest law code that survives, in fragments. Scribes kept records of almost everything: sheep, grain, workers’ wages.

clips.send: Empire of Alexander the Great. 334–323 BCE, then fought over by his generals. Alexander of Macedon conquered the whole Persian Empire in about ten years, from Egypt to the Indus. After he died in Babylon in 323 BCE, his generals split the empire.

clips.send: Sumerian city-states. c. 3500–2334 BCE. Dozens of independent cities — Uruk, Ur, Lagash and more — each with its own king, walls, canals and a temple for its god. Uruk grew to perhaps 40,000 people around 3000 BCE, one of the first true cities. The Sumerians invented cuneiform writing (c. 3200 BCE) and the wheel.

clips.send: Persian (Achaemenid) Empire. Persia ruled Egypt from 525 BCE. In 525 BCE King Cambyses II added Egypt. Now one empire held both Mesopotamia and Egypt — and reached the Indus. Egypt broke free 404–343 BCE before Persia took it back (not shown).

clips.send: 古埃及：早王朝与古王国。约公元前3100—前2181年。约公元前3100年，上埃及（南部）和下埃及（北部）初步统一，传说统一者是那尔迈（美尼斯）。古王国是“金字塔时代”：左塞尔阶梯金字塔（约公元前2650年）和胡夫金字塔（约公元前2560年）。法老被看作神的化身，拥有至高无上的权力。

clips.send: 阿卡德王国。约公元前2334—前2154年。阿卡德的萨尔贡征服了苏美尔各城市，建立起常被称为“第一个帝国”的国家：许多民族归一个统治者管辖。它存在了不到200年就瓦解了。

clips.send: 古巴比伦王国（汉谟拉比）。约公元前1894—前1595年 · 汉谟拉比在位约公元前1792—前1750年。约公元前18世纪，古巴比伦国王汉谟拉比统一了两河流域的大部分地区。他颁布了《汉谟拉比法典》——刻在石柱上的282条法律，是现存世界上第一部比较完整的成文法典。法典宣扬国王的权力来自神。

clips.send: 古埃及：新王国。约公元前1550—前1069年 · 图特摩斯三世时（约公元前1450年）最强盛。公元前15世纪图特摩斯三世统治时，古埃及成为地跨亚非两洲的大帝国，从努比亚一直到幼发拉底河。这时的法老葬在底比斯附近的帝王谷，图坦卡蒙（约公元前1323年下葬）就是其中之一。

clips.send: 苏美尔城邦。约公元前3500—前2334年。几十个独立的城市——乌鲁克、乌尔、拉格什等——各有自己的国王、城墙、水渠和供奉本城神灵的神庙。约公元前3000年，乌鲁克可能已有约4万人，是最早真正的城市之一。苏美尔人发明了楔形文字（约公元前3200年）和车轮。

clips.send: 乌尔第三王朝。约公元前2112—前2004年。乌尔纳姆国王修建了宏伟的乌尔塔庙，颁布了《乌尔纳姆法典》——现存最早的法典，只留下残片。书吏几乎什么都记账：羊、粮食、工人的报酬。
